versions.changelog:
- Updated usage instructions to prefer users' existing patterns in test naming when available.
- Expanded SKILL.md documentation, adding sections for description, use case, license, risks, references, and ethical considerations.

Initial release of Unit Test Namer.

- Suggests clear unit-test function names based on a short behavior description.
- Provides 2–3 naming options in `test_...` or `it(...)` formats.
- Helps improve test clarity when authoring new tests or renaming vague test names.
- Offers usage instructions, naming patterns, and examples.
- No dependencies required; text-only usage.
